title: pm: first-touch sweep follow-ups from the #33484 review (oldest-first paging, ⑤ pre-filter, H24 on blocked and on-hold, CI wiring)
body:
domain:skills#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5pjSPT7ui2EUcunaVb

Filing gate: ① (follow-ups owed by work in flight). Contract review 6885812549 of PR #33510 (card #33484) left these as nits for a follow-up card. They are measured on the PR's head `451ada3e` and read on `main` once #33510 lands.

## What lands

1. **Sweep paging (N2).** `scripts/pm/first-touch-sweep.mjs` reads pages newest-first. If a card closes between two page reads, a still-open card can be skipped while the counts still match. Walk oldest-first and dedupe by number. Add a self-test row that shifts the page window.
2. **Disjunction ⑤ pre-filter (N3).** ⑤ pre-filters on a card's current labels, so a card whose creation-minute `pm:queue` or `priority:*` has since come off is never judged. Read the label timeline, or say in the header which reading ⑤ makes and why.
3. **Half-state rule H24 (N4).** `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` H24 checks an assignee on `pm:queue` only. Since #33484, `SKILL.md` names an assignee on `pm:blocked` or `pm:on-hold` a half-state too. Widen H24 to all three and pin it in the self-test. Triage then repairs the open cards it finds (2 `pm:blocked` cards carried an assignee at filing).
4. **CI wiring (N7).** The sweep's `--self-test` runs nowhere automatically. Add a root `package.json` script and a `lint.yml` step beside the other pm self-tests. `lint.yml` is under `.github/workflows/**`, so this part is governed and the maintainer lands it.

## Scope

`scripts/pm/**`, root `package.json`, `.github/workflows/lint.yml`. No published package moves, so `skip-changeset`. `Clause-②: no`.

Blocked-by: #33484 (PR #33510)
